ceiling_verdict: APPROVED - Cloudflare Startup Program credits cover first-party Workers AI; owner raised the campaign ceiling to 3,000,000 neurons on 2026-08-10
what_changed_since_the_first_attempt: The first attempt recorded 401s on the AI model catalogue and on the GraphQL neuron-usage query. BOTH were transient. On re-attempt they return 200, exactly as the D1 7403 did.
That means neuron consumption IS machine-readable on this account, and the model catalogue IS enumerable. Real per-model, per-day usage is now recorded below.
Billing endpoints are a different story: six distinct endpoint shapes were tried and ALL return a stable 403 (permission), not 401 (auth). This is a genuine scope denial, not a race.

MACHINE_VERIFIED.evidence: GraphQL viewer.accounts.aiInferenceAdaptiveGroups returns per-model and per-day totalNeurons for account b6009ce8df89884b79e4f6fa49e52942.
MACHINE_VERIFIED.third_party_billing_note: AI_GATEWAY_ID is unset in wrangler.jsonc, the AI binding is direct, and every model in use or under consideration is @cf/ first-party with partner=false. There is no configured path by which a billable third-party provider could be hit, silently or otherwise.
MACHINE_VERIFIED.free_cap_evidence: Workers AI includes 10,000 neurons/day; on the Free plan requests are refused beyond it. This account recorded 216,347 neurons on 2026-08-08, 102,219 on 2026-08-06 and 98,799 on 2026-08-02 - 10x to 21x that allocation - and the LLM-judge campaign logged 0 errors and 0 retries across all 1,540 questions on the 2026-08-08 run. A hard-capped Free account cannot produce that. Workers AI is therefore on a paid or credited path.

PLANNED_EXPERIMENT_BUDGETS.note: Derived from the measured per-call costs above, not from estimates.
PLANNED_EXPERIMENT_BUDGETS.requested_ceiling_rationale: The original 1,500,000-neuron ceiling was owner-authorized on 2026-08-09. After the invalid concurrent reranking attempt consumed budget without producing evidence, the owner explicitly raised the hard campaign ceiling to 3,000,000 neurons on 2026-08-10 for the sequential frozen-subset rerun and later decisive V3 validation.

authorization.basis: Owner confirmation: account enrolled in Cloudflare Startup Program with the $10,000 credit offer. Startup credits are applied automatically to eligible usage-based products, cover Workers AI, and are reflected through invoices/credit deductions rather than as a normal dashboard credit balance. AI Gateway is separately excluded from Startup-credit coverage.
authorization.why_the_dashboard_balance_was_the_wrong_: The ordinary AI Gateway / Unified Billing credit balance is a different facility from the Startup Program allowance. Asking for it would have returned a number that does not govern this spend.
authorization.permitted_path: FIRST-PARTY Workers AI only: @cf/ models with partner=false, invoked through the direct AI binding.
authorization.stop_condition: If any planned model changes from first-party partner=false Workers AI to a partner/third-party billing path, STOP before invoking it.
